title: Glienicke Bridge - Quick Summary
items: **Where it is:** over the Havel between Berlin-Wannsee and Potsdam. The steel bridge dates from 1907.
**Why the Bridge of Spies:** East and West swapped agents and prisoners here three times, in 1962, 1985 and 1986.
**Getting there:** S7 to Wannsee (about 32 min from Alexanderplatz), then bus 316 for about 13 min. From Potsdam: tram 93.
**Ticket trap:** the Glienicker Brücke stop is zone C. With an AB ticket, get off at Schloss Glienicke and walk.
**On the bridge:** a metal strip marks the old border line, and the two halves are painted in slightly different greens.
**Next door:** Steinstücken, a piece of West Berlin cut off inside the GDR until a road opened on 30 August 1972.
**Winter:** Villa Schöningen opens Fri-Sun 11:00-17:00, the Schloss Glienicke tour only at weekends. Plan for about three hours.
